builds.name: Reference: Critical duel
builds.goal: Reference for Tristana: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged attack carry who rapidly stacks a bomb for burst and jump resets, with growing range supporting later safety. Jumping aggressively depends on actually completing the bomb or obtaining a takedown. Measure four bomb stacks, attack range by level and actual jump reset. AP burst is a risky bomb/ability experiment, not guaranteed crit-carry DPS. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Tristana: Measure four bomb stacks, attack range by level and actual jump reset. AP burst is a risky bomb/ability experiment, not guaranteed crit-carry DPS.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.
